content.text:
No. At about **0.27 s**, cart1’s pushing face hits **ball1’s launch pad before reaching ball1**. Cart1 rebounds, oscillates, and eventually settles against the pad near −0.268 m. Ball1 never starts moving, so none of the downstream chain reactions occurs. Ball5 remains retained on the stationary seesaw; no ball passes through either ring or is launched.

The initial support contacts are not the failure. The revision below narrows both ramp launch pads and places their rear edges clear of cart1’s pushing face. Ball1’s position and the nominal 0.50 m approach remain unchanged. **This revised world has not yet been run.**
